supersedesForThisFamilyOnly: The historical DE memo's reference to an additional $75 court filing fee on the mandatory SBI branch. Historical shared records are retained, not silently rewritten.
finding: The current DSP process specifies an initial $72 expungement application charge and, only after mandatory eligibility, signed paperwork returned within 30 days of receipt with a $75 money order payable to Delaware State Police. It does not add a third court filing charge to this agency process. A discretionary court petition is a separate route.
implementation: State the two agency charges with their conditions; remove the extra court fee and any instruction to buy a separate personal-use record as a substitute; retain automatic-process screening and legal handoff boundaries.
